newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 2.52 bln reais in Treasury papers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 2.52 bln reais in Treasury papers.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of the National Treasury, raised 2.52 billion reais during an auction Monday of two series of National Treasury Letters known as LTNs, dealers said.
A total of 1.365 billon reais of 183-day LTNs, due in October 15 1997, was sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.210 percent a month.
The Central Bank also sold 1.155 billion reais of 365-day, due in April 15 1998, at a call money rate of 2.285 percent a month.
